source.snapshot_note: sha256 of the raw HTML this transcription was checked against. Not re-verifiable in CI: the page is not committed and cannot be fetched there. Re-check with --html-dir after any refetch; an HTML hash moves with ANY byte of the page (ads, sidebar, a date), so a moved hash means "read the board diff", not "the boards changed". Sentences are compared against the page with its tags dropped.

quotes.verbatim: ここでは、STSD(Super T-Spin Double)という、TSDを2回打つことができる中盤テンプレについて紹介していきます。
※投稿主であるI凜さんに許可を得た上で動画を掲載しています。
基本形とラインの消し方
基本形は上図の通りです。
ここから、以下のように%Tを縦向きに入れてTSDを打つと、もう一度TSDを打てる形が残ります。
元地形からの組み方と特徴
1つ目の組み方としては、3列の下穴から%J・%Lを立てて作る方法です。
真ん中に穴があっても問題なく組むことができます。
屋根のミノは高さによって使い分けてください。
おじゃまブロックの出現で上図のような穴ができてしまうと、不発になってしまいます。
このような場合、%J(左右反転の場合は%L)を回転入れすることによってリカバリーができます(ブーメラン)。

nodes.label: the T stood up into it, nub left: a TSD clearing the two rows over the nub
what the TSD leaves: a TSD slot under the old roof
a J and an L stood in the well
the same, over a hole in the row below
an I for the roof, the stack right of the well one row taller (the roof itself is no higher than the Z one)
a garbage row arrives with its hole under the T's column
the T drops through into the hole: a TSD on the wrong rows (不発)
the recovery: a J spun in (the boomerang), clearing two rows that are not adjacent

nodes.reading: build3.jl_hole less its j and l: the 3-wide well over a row holed at column 1
roof.z less its j and z: a 3-wide well three rows deep, no step
roof.i less its j and i: a 3-wide well four rows deep, no step

variants.window_note: in basic.spin's frame, row 0 the top: the bounding box of the T, the roof above it and the follow-up slot. Row 0 (headroom) and everything right of column 3 is outside: the cleared rows' cells there are entailed by the clear (NaiveClauseForced), the rest is grey on the page. Occupancy only, never colour; garbage is filled.

followup.note: the flat T into the slot under the old roof. On basic.after as DRAWN it clears two rows; on the board the spin actually leaves it would clear one, because row 4 right of the roof is only filled on the drawing (basic.after:after).

cross_source.note: the window, by the gate's predicate (technique_transcription.window_fires), over every U-slot board of every committed *-routes.json, with the U cells as the T. `fires` is the independent drawer (harddrop's SDPC Spin page, another author); `also` is measured and named, not explained.

known_discrepancies.note: the board after the basic STSD draws row 4 filled from column 3 to the wall; the spin itself leaves only column 3 there (and its surviving t cell is drawn grey). Read as the page assuming the right side has been stacked up to the roof; the follow-up slot is checked on the board as drawn.

the misfire draws the J's cell in a cleared row as C (grey) where recover.j draws its J's cleared cells as J, so the j there is three cells: the renderer convention applied inconsistently, not a different piece
